name: UpdateWorkItem
label: Update Work Item
description: Updates the fields or status of an existing work item.

fields.name: WorItemId
fields.label: WorkItem ID
fields.description: Enter the unique identifier of the work item you want to update.

fields.name: Status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Select the new status to assign to the work item.

fields.name: WorkItemRemark
fields.label: Remark
fields.description: Enter the remark for the work item.

fields.name: ShouldUpdateWorkItemData
fields.label: Update WorkItem Data
fields.description: Enable this option if you also want to update the data payload of the work item.

fields.name: UpdateWorkItemData
fields.label: Work Item Data
fields.description: Provide the updated work item data in JSON format. This will replace the existing data stored with the work item.
